task_1_review_deception.training_regime: Cross-Validation on Gold (N=100); Out-of-Domain Transfer from Silver (N=600)
task_1_review_deception.caveats: Small gold positive support (N=17); require completion of 500 pending tasks for full production training.

task_2_pricing_anomalies.training_regime: Robust Median & Interquartile Range (IQR) Corridors by Subcategory & Brand
task_2_pricing_anomalies.caveats: Zero external gold fraud labels exist; statistical anomalies must not be treated as confirmed legal fraud.

task_3_image_reuse_and_tampering.task_name: Image Similarity, Perceptual Hashing & Cross-Listing Reuse
task_3_image_reuse_and_tampering.caveats: Catalog reuse is often legitimate manufacturer stock imagery; requires multi-modal corroboration to confirm fraud.

task_4_packaging_ocr_brand_alignment.task_name: Physical Packaging OCR & Brand Token Verification
task_4_packaging_ocr_brand_alignment.training_regime: WinRT Native OCR + Bounding Box Geometry + Entity Subgraph Matching
task_4_packaging_ocr_brand_alignment.caveats: Non-cosmetic or textless products legitimately lack typography (26% zero text rate).

task_5_seller_identity_trust.task_name: Seller Identity Governance & Platform Pool Separation
task_5_seller_identity_trust.caveats: Zero individual merchant IDs exist; supervised merchant credit scoring is strictly ineligible without individual KYC.

task_6_multimodal_product_fraud.modality: Multimodal Fusion (NLP + CV + Pricing + Graph + OCR)
task_6_multimodal_product_fraud.training_regime: Corroboration Logic across independent evidence modules (v1.7 Central Engine)
task_6_multimodal_product_fraud.caveats: Supervised end-to-end binary classifier cannot be defensibly trained without real legal seizure/settlement labels.

explicit_annotation_requirements_for_sup.workstream_A_review_queue: Complete double-blind adjudication of the 500 pending reviews (2 annotators + 1 lead, ~25 human hours).
explicit_annotation_requirements_for_sup.workstream_B_vision_language: Annotate 250 image-title pairs for genuine physical mismatch vs promotional styling.
explicit_annotation_requirements_for_sup.workstream_C_seller_kyc: Collect GSTIN/trade license KYC on 100 merchant accounts to transition from platform aggregate pools to individual seller scoring.
explicit_annotation_requirements_for_sup.workstream_D_legal_counterfeit: Partner with brand rights-holders or e-commerce legal teams to obtain 50-100 verified counterfeit takedown notices.
